analyst.summary: Voltamp is a well-run, debt-free transformer manufacturer benefiting from India's power grid and data-centre capex cycle, with revenue up over 11% for the year. However, profit actually declined this year -- Q4 profit nearly halved -- due to raw-material cost pressure and one-time provisions, and the stock still trades at over 30 times earnings. We rate this a Hold: a quality balance sheet in a structurally growing industry, but the near-term numbers don't yet support the current valuation.
